report_metadata.title: GFlowNet-Prover Autonomous Evaluation & Error Taxonomy Report

InvariantSynthesisMiss.description: GFlowNet explores vulnerable transition but no synthesized invariant triggers on corrupted state.
InvariantSynthesisMiss.remediation_protocol: Retrain HgtInvariantSynthesizer with augmented negative state pairs and expand domain invariant templates.

FlowUnderexplored.description: Required sequence of FunctionNode calls is never sampled within trajectory budget.
FlowUnderexplored.remediation_protocol: Increase RND curiosity novelty coefficient beta and off-policy replay temperature tau_temp.

SmtSolverTimeout.description: Concolic/SMT solver times out at 5,000 ms on non-linear arithmetic or nested hashes.
SmtSolverTimeout.remediation_protocol: Apply concretization of non-critical storage variables in gfn-symbolic concretizer before invoking Bitwuzla.

RevmForgeMismatch.description: Candidate exploit succeeds in RevmArena but fails concrete verification in forge test (FPR > 0).
RevmForgeMismatch.remediation_protocol: Enforce exact revm::primitives::SpecId::CANCUN parity, match gas limits, and synchronize calldata selectors.

incidents.symptom: Step 0 execution failed on VaultErc4626.deposit calldata due to parameter count mismatch.
incidents.root_cause: deposit(uint256) overload missing in Solidity fixture while calldata encoded 1 parameter (36 bytes).
incidents.resolution: Implemented overloaded deposit(uint256) function in VaultErc4626.sol and aligned calldata selector 0xb6b55f25.

incidents.symptom: Unrecognized function selector 0x704b6f04 for contract GovTimelock.
incidents.root_cause: Selector typo in GovTimelock test calldata string.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with cast sig computed hash 0x704b6c02 corresponding to setAdmin(address).

PatchRegression.description: Counterexample patch blocks exploit but causes existing unit tests in test/ to fail.
PatchRegression.remediation_protocol: Refine minimal negated precondition strengthening in patch_synthesizer to include caller/state specificity.
